title: Escape template values to prevent HTML injection
instruction: render(template, values) in src/template.mjs replaces {{name}} placeholders (name matches [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, optional spaces inside the braces) with values[name]. Make it safe for HTML text and quoted attribute contexts: escape & < > " ' as & < > " '. Escape '&' first so nothing is double-escaped. Placeholders whose value is undefined or null throw ReferenceError. Non-string values are converted with String() before escaping. Substituted values are never re-scanned for placeholders. Export escapeHtml as well.
